title: A Hierarchy of Risk Certificates for Representation-Based Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33333v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Representation-based prediction underlies many machine-learning systems. Yet a fitted predictor's failure to meet an accuracy requirement does not establish that its representation-decoder class cannot meet it. We study optimal population mean squared error (MSE) over Lipschitz decoders acting on a fixed representation. For blocks of $b\geq2$ independent and identically distributed (iid) observations, we minimize total squared error (normalized by $b-1$) under pairwise Lipschitz constraints. We prove that expected block scores form nondecreasing lower bounds on optimal class risk and converge to that risk on compact metric feature spaces, although no fixed block size provides a uniform relative guarantee. Verified dual lower bounds and iid calibration observations independent of model development, with bounded targets and predictions, yield simultaneous lower confidence bounds on optimal class risk and upper confidence bounds on fitted

translated_title: 基于表示的预测的风险证书层级体系
translated_abstract: 基于表示的预测是众多机器学习系统的基础。然而，一个拟合的预测器未能满足精度要求，并不能证明其表示-解码器类无法满足该要求。我们研究了作用于固定表示的Lipschitz解码器上的最优总体均方误差（MSE）。对于由 b≥2 个独立同分布观测组成的块，我们在成对Lipschitz约束下最小化总平方误差（以 b-1 归一化）。我们证明了期望块分数构成最优类风险的非递减下界，并在紧致度量特征空间上收敛于该风险，尽管没有任何固定块大小能提供一致的相对保证。经验证的对偶下界，以及与模型开发相互独立、目标值和预测值均有界的独立同分布校准观测，能够给出最优类风险的同步置信下界以及拟合（模型的误差置信上界）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对基于表示的预测的层级式风险证书框架，证明期望块分数构成最优类风险的非递减下界并在紧致空间上收敛于该风险，从而为模型精度提供统计与经验证相结合的置信界。
